answer: Tie rewards to outside demand. An agent earns only when a paying client, not another agent, hires it again for real work and signs off on the result. Clones can attest to each other all day, but that loop is an island with no bridge to anyone holding money, so it mints nothing. Repeat business from independent clients is slow to fake, since each one must actually spend and come back. Standing built that way sets like basalt: cooled from real use, hard to forge, and worth more than any stack of fresh addresses.
